m.description: Slope multiplier for upper linear boundary f(x) = m*x

constraints: f(x) = m*x >= g(x) = x^2 for all x in [0, m]
promptTemplate: Define R as the region bounded above by the line f(x) = {m}x and below by the parabola g(x) = x^2. Find the volume of the solid of revolution formed by revolving R around the y-axis.

canonicalSolution.structure: The curves intersect at x = 0 and x = {m}. Height h(x) = {m}x - x^2. Volume V = \int_{0}^{m} 2\pi x ({m}x - x^2) dx = 2\pi \int_{0}^{m} ({m}x^2 - x^3) dx = 2\pi [{m}x^3/3 - x^4/4]_{0}^{m} = 2\pi (m^4/3 - m^4/4) = 2\pi (m^4/12) = \pi m^4 / 6

hints.template: Find the x-limits of integration by setting {m}x = x^2.
The height of each cylindrical shell is the difference between upper and lower curves: h(x) = f(x) - g(x) = {m}x - x^2.
Set up the shell integral: V = \int_{0}^{{m}} 2\pi x ({m}x - x^2) dx = 2\pi \int_{0}^{{m}} ({m}x^2 - x^3) dx.
